'''Ryan Dare''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 New South Wales State Championship]] on 20 May 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB]], according to Luke Bartter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2362">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-23-nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01d2362/ nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01], DeckTech (Luke "Like" Bartter, 23 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-23-nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01d2362/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
